main_text.l: Arg. VIII. ex canone 16. de clerico concubi-
canone 16. (Dionysio 17.) ὁ δυσὶ γάμοις συμπλακεὶς μὴ τὸ βάπτισμα, ἢ παλαλαὶ ηπησάμενος, ὁ δῶρα ἐπίσκοπος,
ἢ πρεσβύτερος, ἢ διάκονος, ἢ ὅλως τῆς καταλόγος τῆς ἱερατικῆς. Qui post sanctum baptismum duobus conjugiis fuit
potest esse Episcopus, vel presbyter, vel
Diaconus, vel omnino ex numero sacer-
dotali. Primo, quod concubinarium à sa-
cro ministrorum censu arcet, id bona Roma
puniri. Itaque quod hic dicitur, nunc usu
ipsum flagitium, sed tantum ratione infamiæ
ac declarari putat; adeoque eum tantum cujus

page.notes: The first word of the body is a large woodcut initial "I", joined as "ITIDEM". Greek passage transcribed from the scan; some letters uncertain. The marginal note at left is set beside the lower lines of the text and its reference letter "a" appears in the text after "Binio". Text runs on to a final word "jus" printed at the right of the last line.
